data.action: 坐在更衣室长凳上，黑白战术连体衣拉链滑落至腰侧，双手轻按长凳边缘，修长双腿并拢斜放，侧头露出无口冷娇浅笑
data.camera: cowboy shot, sitting on wooden bench, soft locker room lighting
data.description: 任务归来后的 C&C 专属更衣室内，时坐在长木凳上更换装备。紧致的黑白战术衣拉链拉开至腰间，露出光滑无瑕的后背与优美肩颈线。整齐的储物柜前，她双腿并拢斜坐，双手撑在身侧凳面，金发随侧头动作轻垂，深蓝双瞳带着任务圆满达成的纯真与信任。
data.promptProse: Toki sitting sideways on a wooden locker room bench, black and white combat suit unzipped down to the waist revealing bare shoulders and back, blonde side ponytail gently falling over neck, blue halo, blue eyes, legs placed neatly together, hands resting on bench, soft warm indoor lighting, rows of metal lockers in background.
data.title: 飞鸟马时 · C&C更衣室半脱
